**Bug-fix release from the first lab run of `Install-SoaToolkit.ps1 -Step All`: the Delegate step, the monitor's lock-out / expiry checks and `-WhatIf` now work as documented. A new static check prevents this class of defect.**

> The end-to-end lab validation of the 2.x scripts (L1-L20) is in progress ([docs/VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.0.5/docs/VALIDATION.md)). Validate in your own lab first.

## Fixed

All three defects exist since 2.0.0.

- **`-Step Delegate` stopped with "Cannot convert null to type System.Guid".**
  - Cause: PowerShell variable names are case-insensitive, and the steps of `Install-SoaToolkit.ps1` share one scope. `$g = Get-ADGroup ...` replaced the GUID table `$G`, and `foreach ($s in ...)` replaced the SID table `$S`.
  - Effect: the step failed before its first ACE; no ACE was written with a wrong value.
  - Fix: the tables are now `$KnownGuid` / `$KnownSid`. Re-run `-Step All`; it is idempotent.
- **The monitor never reported locked-out or expired accounts.** In `Watch-CloudUserConformance.ps1`, the per-user value `$ucc` replaced the flag table `$Ucc` (now `$UccFlag`).
- **`-WhatIf` could create GPOs.**
  - Cause: preference variables do not reach functions of a script module. `New-SoaGpo` was called without `-WhatIf:$WhatIfPreference` in the steps BatchLogonGpo, KirGpo and AuditConfig.
  - Effect: a dry run that reached these steps created empty, unlinked GPOs.
  - Fix: `-WhatIf` is now passed. If you made a dry run with an earlier version, check GPMC for such GPOs.
- **`-Step All -WhatIf` on a fresh domain stopped at the Gmsa step.** Steps that need the host group or the gMSA from an earlier step now report `(WhatIf) ... not simulated further` and continue.

## Changed

Diagnostics GPO (`Set-SoaDiagnosticsGpo.ps1`, `-Step DiagnosticsGpo`):

- **Marker everywhere it can be:**
  - in the GPO comment, also when the script runs on its own without a configuration;
  - in the description of the GPP registry item (GPMC tab *Common*), added to existing toolkit GPOs by `-Action Enable`.
- **Foreign GPOs are left alone:** a GPO of the same name without the marker is not enabled or deleted without `-Force`. Install records it as *PreExisting* and does not touch its link.
- **1.x GPO adoption is guarded:** the toolkit 1.x GPO is adopted only if its item removes the value when the GPO no longer applies. Otherwise the step reports FAIL with instructions and changes nothing.

## New

- **`tools/Test-SoaScriptScope.ps1`**, part of `Invoke-SoaStaticChecks.ps1` and the unit tests on PowerShell 7 and Windows PowerShell 5.1. It checks two things:
  - no script-level value is overwritten later in the same scope;
  - every module function with `SupportsShouldProcess` receives `-WhatIf`.

  Both checks report the defects above when run against 2.0.4.

## Upgrade from 2.0.4

1. Replace the toolkit files and keep your `SoaToolkit.config.psd1`; there are no new keys.
2. Run `.\Install-SoaToolkit.ps1 -Step All -WhatIf`, then without `-WhatIf`.
   - The steps that already ran report SAME.
   - Delegate, AllowList, DeployTasks and Verify complete the installation.
   - DeployTasks puts the fixed monitor on every host.

Details: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.0.5/CHANGELOG.md)

## Verify the download

Compare the SHA-256 of the asset with the digest GitHub shows next to it. The zip contains `SHA256SUMS.txt` for every file:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\cloudsync-soa-toolkit-2.0.5.zip -Algorithm SHA256
Get-ChildItem -Recurse | Unblock-File
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/compare/v2.0.4...v2.0.5
